source: Create a large, grand futuristic race track with a sleek metallic sci-fi aesthetic. The track should be a sprawling multi-section circuit with the following features: - A wide main track surface with clean white/silver metallic appearance - Glowing blue energy strips running along the edges of the track (neon-like accent lines) - Multiple curved sections and turns forming a complete circuit loop - Ramps and elevation changes for dynamic racing - A tunnel section with glowing blue interior lighting - Decorative side barriers with sci-fi styling - Start/finish line area with a futuristic archway gate - Tiered grandstand seating area on one side - Support pillars and structural elements with metallic sci-fi design - Blue energy accents and holographic-style decorations throughout The overall style should evoke Mass Effect or Star Wars podracing — clean surfaces, blue energy accents, and a grand sense of scale. Expose these editable attributes: - TrackWidth (how wide the track surface is) - TrackLength (overall scale of the circuit) - NeonColor (the color of the glowing energy strips and accents) - SurfaceColor (the main track surface color) - BarrierHeight (height of the side barriers) - GlowIntensity (brightness of the neon accents)
scene_prompt: Create a large, grand futuristic racing circuit with a sprawling multi-section loop. The wide main track has clean white and silver metallic surfaces, glowing blue energy strips along both edges, sci-fi side barriers, sweeping curved turns, ramps, and elevation changes. Include a blue-lit tunnel section, a start/finish area beneath a futuristic archway gate, and tiered grandstand seating along one side. Metallic support pillars and structural elements frame elevated sections, with blue energy accents and holographic-style decorations distributed throughout the circuit for a sleek, high-tech sense of scale.
blob:
### 1. Genre
The dominant genre is Racing: the original request is for a complete competitive circuit, not an open vehicle showcase.

### 2. Shape and preset
Use `route-circuit`, a single closed futuristic loop with sweeping turns, ramps, and one tunnel section. This matches the Circuit Racing preset, retaining its circuit topology and guardrailed raceway while adding the explicitly requested grandstand and energy-lined visual treatment.

### 3. Config requirements
Use `startpoint-line` as a broad start/finish stripe beneath the futuristic archway. Use `trigger-finish` as the finish detection line integrated into that same archway. Use `trigger-lap` for lap and split detection at the start/finish straight. Use `lane-corridor` as continuous glowing blue energy strips defining both track edges. Use `barrier-guardrail` as sleek metallic sci-fi side barriers around every exposed curve, ramp, and elevated edge. Use `spectator-zone` as tiered grandstand seating along one prominent side of the circuit.

### 4. Layout requirements
Place one `startpoint-line` across the widest straight, immediately before the archway. Place one `trigger-finish` directly under the archway at the end of that straight, and one `trigger-lap` co-located with it so every completed loop crosses the same controlled line. The grandstand needs no placed gameplay marker. The barriers and energy strips are drawn geometry rather than layout placements.

### 5. Layout components
Build one large closed loop dominated by a wide white-and-silver metallic track. Begin with a long start/finish straight and archway in the foreground, then lead into several broad curved sectors, alternating flowing turns with ramped elevation changes. Put a blue-lit enclosed tunnel through one mid-course section, with luminous interior strips and a clearly readable exit. Raise selected track spans on metallic support pillars, but keep the course as one continuous followable surface. Place the tiered grandstand parallel to a major visible straight, outside the barriers. Run glowing blue strips continuously along both track edges, with matching holographic-style decorations at turns and structural nodes. Use sci-fi barriers as the outer boundary; open surrounding void or minimal futuristic terrain should not compete with the circuit. Compose the entire loop legibly from an elevated three-quarter view, with the archway, grandstand, tunnel, and raised sections all visible.

### 6. Render order
Use `authored_plan`: a circuit must be a valid, continuous closed route before it is dressed, so the generated blueprint is authoritative and the images decorate that route.

### 7. Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is huge, driven by the sprawling multi-section circuit, long straights, grandstand, tunnel, and elevated structural spans. Theme: grand clean metallic sci-fi, white and silver surfaces, saturated blue neon energy, holographic accents, Mass Effect / podracing grandeur. Apply `tiered` because the ramped course has substantial elevation changes without requiring stacked racing routes, and `P6` because the circuit must be valid by construction.
